dict.Opțiuni: numele tău, ortografia, AutoCor: Options: your name, spelling, AutoCorrect, AutoSave, the ruler and the panes
dict.Apare la comentarii și la modificările u: Shown on comments and tracked changes.
dict.Debifat: schimbările se scriu în fișier: Unchecked: changes are written to the file only on Ctrl+S. Documents without a file are still kept as drafts (File → Recover…).
dict.Salvare automată: documentul deja salvat: AutoSave: a document already saved to a file saves itself after every change
dict.Semnele de formatare (¶ la sfârșit de pa: Formatting marks (¶ at the end of a paragraph, · for spaces, → for Tab)
dict.Verifică ortografia în timp ce scrii (cu: Check spelling as you type (misspelled words underlined in red)
dict.AutoCorect lucrează în casetele de text: AutoCorrect works in text boxes and tables, with the same rules as in Docs; Backspace right after a correction undoes it.
dict.Salvare automată: prezentarea deja salva: AutoSave: a presentation already saved to a file saves itself after every change (unchecked: only on Ctrl+S)
dict.Completare automată a valorilor din celu: AutoComplete for cell values (the rest of a text already in the column appears as you type)
dict.Salvare automată: tabelul deja salvat în: AutoSave: a workbook already saved to a file saves itself after every change (unchecked: only on Ctrl+S)
dict.AutoCorect cât scrii în celule: ș / ț cu: AutoCorrect as you type in cells: s / t with comma below, TWo INitial CApitals, the replacement list (not in formulas)
